name: pii_redaction
description: Domain-agnostic redaction of transcripts or text: masks private names, phone numbers, emails, street addresses, card / account numbers, government ids, dates of birth and handles; public contacts (a business phone line) stay.
_notes: The PII span head already runs at the 0.3 display floor (recall-leaning), so no overrides are needed; raise head:safety.pii for fewer false masks. Read redacted_text from the result.
